newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end mixed, banks spotlighted.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end mixed, banks spotlighted.

text.p: 1730 GMT - Shares ended mixed with banks in the spotlight.
*Banco Comercial Portugues rose sharply on its first quarter results and speculation about a possible sale of its 20 percent holding in Mundial Confianca.

*Banco Totta fell four percent after announcing a profit drop in the first quarter even if the numbers were not strictly comparable because the bank only began making monthly provisions for tax liabilities this year.
*Dealers said that the stock was also hit by remarks by chairman Luis Champalimaud to an analysts' meeting that the group planned to be less generous with its dividend policy in future.
*Banco Sotto and Portugal Telecom went ex-dividend on Thursday.
*Dealers said that the outlook for Monday would depend on how Wall Street performed today and Friday, which is a holiday in Portugal.
